decisions.topic: Ring Buffer: single aggregate slot per metric vs per-pool expansion
decisions.decision: Ring buffer stores per-metric-type entries (8 types), not per-pool. Pool-level detail is available in /metrics OpenMetrics output where labels can expand pool names. Dashboard shows aggregate pool usage.
decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES #2 (賢いデフォルト > 設定項目を増やす): the ring buffer's purpose is trend visualisation, not per-pool forensics. Prometheus/Grafana handles the latter — VISION §phase_1 explicitly says 'monitoring-stack アプリ for full monitoring'. Keeping 8 fixed metric IDs bounds the ring buffer size without config.
alternatives_rejected: Per-pool ring buffer entries: would require dynamic allocation or a variable-capacity ring buffer, adding complexity. DESIGN_PRINCIPLES #4 (シンプルなモジュラーモノリス) argues against it.

decisions.decision: Cooldown state is kept in-memory (map[string]time.Time in AlertEvaluator). On restart, all cooldowns reset — first collection after restart may fire alerts again.
decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES #2 (賢いデフォルト > 設定項目を増やす) and #5 (reliability > features): persisting cooldown to SQLite would complicate the schema and create another SSOT to keep in sync with config.json. Alert re-fire on restart is acceptable for a home NAS — the operator sees one extra alert, not alert storms.
alternatives_rejected: SQLite cooldown table: over-engineering for v1 home NAS. Adds migration, query, and consistency concerns.

decisions.topic: Notification channel secrets: vault vs config_json field
decisions.decision: Credentials (ntfy token, smtp password, line_notify token) are stored in notification_channels.config_json for v1 simplicity, with credential_state='set' reflecting presence. The vault integration (kv table key 'notify.<id>.secret') is architecture-ready but not wired in v1.
decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES #1 (SSOT config.json + vault): full vault isolation would require vault-read path in the dispatcher and UI. DESIGN_PRINCIPLES #7 (段階的実装 > 完璧な初期実装): the config_json column is root-only readable (state.db at 0600), providing adequate security for a home LAN device. The vault migration is a v1.x item.
alternatives_rejected: Full vault isolation from day 1: adds dispatch latency and vault key-naming complexity. Deferred per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES #7.

decisions.decision: /metrics is mounted under the admin auth middleware in the gateway. Unauthenticated requests are redirected to /login.
decisions.rationale: VISION mentions that Prometheus/Grafana can scrape the endpoint — Prometheus supports basic auth scrape configs. Admin-gating follows the principle of least privilege. An env flag to open /metrics publicly can be added in v1.x without schema changes.
alternatives_rejected: Unauthenticated /metrics: exposes system resource info (pool sizes, CPU load) to anyone on the LAN — not appropriate for a shared NAS.

decisions.topic: Settings page: full page re-render vs partial htmx swap on channel CRUD
decisions.decision: Channel CRUD operations (create/update/delete) return the full settings page HTML; htmx uses outerHTML swap on #channels-card. Test-send returns an inline span fragment.
decisions.rationale: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES #8 (明示的 > 暗黙的): a full page re-render after mutation keeps the UI state consistent without complex htmx fragment management. The channels table is small (home NAS has ≤10 channels), so full re-render is imperceptibly fast. Test-send is a special case returning just the result span to avoid disrupting the table layout.
alternatives_rejected: Fine-grained row swaps: increases template fragmentation and makes the HTML harder to debug. Not worth it for a list that rarely has more than 5 rows.
